note: The brand words, in one place. Everything that shows a name to a user reads from here (or is checked against it by scripts/check-brand.mjs). `idePlugin` is the one name a marketplace gets to veto: VS Code requires `displayName` to be globally unique, and "Cinder" was already taken there by another extension, so the IDE plugins carry a qualifier — and the guard checks that field exactly, because a name that drifts back to a taken one only fails at publish time. The identifier layer is NOT here and is NOT free to move: repotory_* tool prefixes, the repotory / repotory-mcp / repotory-server binaries, the repotory data directory and repotory.db, the MCP server name, the plugin ids, the npm package and the DB sentinel are interfaces, not brands — changing any of them breaks every existing installation. ADR-0049.
